prompt: Illustration painted on a WOOD PANEL, visible wood grain showing through matte paint. SIMPLE and CALM: big flat shapes, generous empty space, only sparing line detail — NOT dense, NOT busy, NOT intricately hatched. Naive storybook charm with gentle whimsy. Strictly limited palette: pale bone-grey painted ground, FLAT solid black, white, and ONE accent of glowing BIOLUMINESCENT GREEN (foxfire — pale green-cyan light). The only inhabitants are SMALL ANIMAL-LIKE BEINGS rendered as simple solid black silhouettes, each with a distinctive CURLED SPIRAL FIDDLEHEAD EAR on either side of the head. Absolutely NO human figures, NO people. No text, no lettering, no runes, no glyphs. A single tall standing stone alone on flat open ground under a big flat black sky. The stone is simply drawn with a few contour lines and a patch of moss. A slim band and one small box are fitted to it, with a single cable curving down to the ground. A short vertical column of simple TALLY MARKS on its face glows soft BIOLUMINESCENT GREEN. One tiny black being with curled spiral ears stands at its base looking up, dwarfed. A low line of simple pale hills far behind. Vast quiet, lots of empty space.
